title: LINE01 live
description: Live process values of LINE01 from the historian (InfluxDB 3 Core, ADR-0019/0022)

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: UNS session (one per Godot start); 'latest' follows the newest session

query.query: SELECT 'latest' AS session UNION ALL SELECT session FROM (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM plc01) ORDER BY session = 'latest' DESC, session DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN '${session}' = 'latest' THEN max(session) ELSE '${session}' END AS sid FROM plc01

links.title: AAS Web UI
links.tooltip: BaSyx AAS Web UI (device, line and workpiece AAS)

panels.title: State
panels.description: Current PackML state of LINE01 (PLC01 packml_state)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT packml_state FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND packml_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "State"

panels.title: Parts (session)
panels.description: Part counters of PLC01 in the selected session (parts_total, parts_ok, parts_nok)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT parts_total FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND parts_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Total", (SELECT parts_ok FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND parts_ok IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "OK", (SELECT parts_nok FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND parts_nok IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "NOK"

panels.title: Reject rate
panels.description: parts_nok / parts_total of the session

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(coalesce((SELECT parts_nok FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND parts_nok IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS DOUBLE) / (SELECT parts_total FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND parts_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Reject rate"

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Inspected parts per hour in the selected time range (ideal at 12 s takt: 300/h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(parts_total) * 3600.0 / ((CAST($__timeTo AS BIGINT) - CAST($__timeFrom AS BIGINT)) / 1e9) AS "Throughput" FROM plc01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND parts_total > 0

panels.title: Line power
panels.description: Sum of the latest power value of all devices (incl. compressed-air equivalent of AC01)

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce((SELECT power FROM ac01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM rb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM cv01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM qs01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM lb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM lb02 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) + coalesce((SELECT power FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS "Line power"

panels.title: Robot cycles
panels.description: RB01 cycle_count and KLT exchanges (KLTA01 + KLTB01 exchange_count)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT cycle_count FROM rb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND cycle_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "RB01 cycles", (SELECT exchange_count FROM klta01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND exchange_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT exchange_count FROM kltb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND exchange_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "KLT exchanges"

panels.title: PackML state
panels.description: PLC01 packml_state over time (ISA-TR88 states)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, v AS "PackML state" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, packml_state AS v FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND packml_state IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND packml_state IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT packml_state AS v FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND packml_state IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: OEE (session)
panels.description: ISO 22400 like the HMI: availability = EXECUTE time / planned time (not STOPPED/IDLE), performance = parts_total x 12 s ideal cycle (AC01 takt_time) / EXECUTE time, quality = parts_ok / parts_total

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT packml_state AS st, (CAST(coalesce(lead(time) OVER (ORDER BY time), (SELECT max(time) FROM cv01 WHERE session = '${sid}')) AS BIGINT) - CAST(time AS BIGINT)) / 1e9 AS dur FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND packml_state IS NOT NULL), d AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN st = 6 THEN dur ELSE 0 END) AS run, sum(CASE WHEN st NOT IN (0, 2, 4) THEN greatest(dur, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS planned FROM s), c AS (SELECT max(parts_total) AS total, max(parts_ok) AS ok FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}') SELECT d.run / d.planned AS "Availability", least(c.total * 12.0 / d.run, 1.0) AS "Performance", CAST(c.ok AS DOUBLE) / c.total AS "Quality", (d.run / d.planned) * least(c.total * 12.0 / d.run, 1.0) * CAST(c.ok AS DOUBLE) / c.total AS "OEE" FROM d, c

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: PLC01 alarm_code (highest-priority active alarm, docs/interfaces/scenarios.md)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, v AS "Alarm" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, alarm_code AS v FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND alarm_code IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND alarm_code IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT alarm_code AS v FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND alarm_code IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Stack light SL01
panels.description: SL01 red_on, amber_on, green_on, buzzer_on

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, v AS "Red" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, red_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND red_on IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND red_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT red_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND red_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, v AS "Amber" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, amber_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND amber_on IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND amber_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT amber_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND amber_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, v AS "Green" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, green_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND green_on IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND green_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT green_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND green_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, v AS "Buzzer" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, buzzer_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND buzzer_on IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND buzzer_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT buzzer_on AS v FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND buzzer_on IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Parts per minute (OK / NOK)
panels.description: Increments of PLC01 parts_ok / parts_nok per minute

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, sum(CASE WHEN parts_ok > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "OK", sum(CASE WHEN parts_nok > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "NOK" FROM plc01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Reject rate (cumulative)
panels.description: parts_nok / parts_total of the session at every inspected part

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, "Reject rate" FROM (SELECT time, CAST(coalesce(max(parts_nok) OVER w, 0) AS DOUBLE) / max(parts_total) OVER w AS "Reject rate" FROM plc01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND (parts_total IS NOT NULL OR parts_nok IS NOT NULL) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)) WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Power per device (stacked)
panels.description: Mean electrical power per 10 s from each device's energy counter (kWh -> W); the stack is the line power. AC01 includes the compressed-air equivalent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "AC01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM ac01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "RB01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM rb01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "CV01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM cv01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "QS01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM qs01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "LB01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM lb01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "LB02" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM lb02 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 3600000.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "SL01" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(energy) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM sl01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND energy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy per device (session)
panels.description: Energy counter increase per device in the selected session

targets.rawSql: SELECT device, energy FROM (SELECT 'AC01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM ac01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'RB01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM rb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'CV01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM cv01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'QS01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM qs01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'LB01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM lb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'LB02' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM lb02 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'SL01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}') ORDER BY energy DESC

panels.title: Line energy
panels.description: Sum of the energy counter increase of all devices in the session

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(energy) AS "Energy" FROM (SELECT 'AC01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM ac01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'RB01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM rb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'CV01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM cv01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'QS01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM qs01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'LB01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM lb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'LB02' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM lb02 WHERE session = '${sid}' UNION ALL SELECT 'SL01' AS device, max(energy) - min(energy) AS energy FROM sl01 WHERE session = '${sid}')

panels.title: Compressed air
panels.description: AC01 air_consumption increase in the session (normal litres)

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(air_consumption) - min(air_consumption) AS "Compressed air" FROM ac01 WHERE session = '${sid}'

panels.title: QS01 colour distance ΔE*ab per part
panels.description: QS01 delta_e (CIE76) of every measured cap; limit 25 (recipe DeltaEMax / QS01 tolerance_delta_e)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, delta_e AS "ΔE*ab" FROM qs01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND delta_e IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: AC01 leak rate per part
panels.description: AC01 last_leak_rate (pressure decay at 6 bar); limit 1.0 cm³/min (recipe LeakRateMax)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, last_leak_rate AS "Leak rate" FROM ac01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND last_leak_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: AC01 stroke time per part
panels.description: AC01 last_stroke_time (function test at 6 bar); recipe limits 0.28 … 0.36 s

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, last_stroke_time AS "Stroke time" FROM ac01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND last_stroke_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: RB01 cycle time
panels.description: Time between two increments of RB01 cycle_count (pick & place cycle incl. waiting for the next part; ideal = takt 12 s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, "Cycle time" FROM (SELECT time, (CAST(time AS BIGINT) - CAST(lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS BIGINT)) / 1e9 AS "Cycle time" FROM rb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND cycle_count IS NOT NULL) WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Compressed air flow AC01
panels.description: Mean flow per 10 s from the AC01 air_consumption counter (Nl -> Nl/min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, (e - lag(e) OVER (ORDER BY t)) * 60.0 / ((CAST(te AS BIGINT) - lag(CAST(te AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY t)) / 1e9) AS "Air flow" FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS t, max(air_consumption) AS e, max(time) AS te FROM ac01 WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND session = '${sid}' AND air_consumption IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: KLT fill levels
panels.description: KLTA01 / KLTB01 fill_count (capacity 12; drops to 0 at an exchange)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, v AS "KLT A (OK)" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, fill_count AS v FROM klta01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM klta01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT fill_count AS v FROM klta01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, v AS "KLT B (NOK)" FROM (SELECT greatest(time, $__timeFrom) AS time, fill_count AS v FROM kltb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time >= (SELECT coalesce(max(time), $__timeFrom) FROM kltb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeFrom) AND time <= $__timeTo UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo AS time, v FROM (SELECT fill_count AS v FROM kltb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY time

panels.title: KLT fill now
panels.description: Current fill_count of both KLTs (PLC01 klt_capacity 12)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT fill_count FROM klta01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "KLT A (OK)", (SELECT fill_count FROM kltb01 WHERE session = '${sid}' AND fill_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "KLT B (NOK)"
